What do you want to improve first?

This tool creates a plan on your device. It does not contact customers, publish anything or start a paid membership.

Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your organization name, location, service area, category and website.
  2. Explain credentials, accessibility, eligibility, current capacity and how families should contact you.
  3. Create one caregiver preparation topic without collecting private health or account information.
  4. Track listing interest separately from clients, placements and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Protect vulnerable people and private health information.
  • Do not guarantee eligibility, availability or outcomes.
  • Paid status never changes safety information or ordinary directory placement.
